races.name: Roscommon Racecourse (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict: RESURGENCE went close at Navan before things failed to go to plan on handicap debut at Listowel, but he remains relatively unexposed and is taken to make the breakthrough back in maiden company in first-time cheekpieces. State of Wyoming caught the eye staying on at the Curragh a fortnight ago and may progress again in a visor, while Karrygrant sets the standard but looks vulnerable to improvers.

runners.note: €1,000 yearling, Ribchester colt. Half-brother to 3 winners, including useful 5f-1m winner Earls and 1½m winner Pearl Jewel.

Calyx gelding. Caught the eye when sixth of 24 in 6f Curragh maiden in April. Matched that form when third to Valentino Eclipse in similar event there on return from 5-month break last time. Should be suited by the step
Showed only greenness when last of 12 in 7f maiden at Cork on debut. Gelded since.
Well beaten in maidens.

Fair maiden who has finished in the frame 4 times this year, posting his best effort when 2¾ lengths second of 14 to Follow Me in handicap at Punchestown in September. Possibly found race coming too soon when below form
Alkumait colt. Showed nothing when well beaten in 7f maiden at Galway on debut.

Proving expensive to follow, finishing runner-up 5 times in 10 starts, including last 2, beaten 1¾ lengths in 9-runner maiden at Killarney on latest. First-time blinkers applied and sets the standard.
Has failed to beat a rival in 3 maidens (gelded after debut).

Promising when reaching the frame in maidens at the end of last summer and backed up those runs 12 months on when second of 13 in 1m maiden at Navan last month. Just matched that when sixth on handicap debut last time bu
Starman gelding. Better effort in maidens when 9½ lengths fifth of 11 to Valentino Eclipse at Curragh last time. Goes up in trip now.

Well-bred Night of Thunder colt who stepped up on debut effort and caught the eye when 7 lengths sixth of 18 to Come What May in 1¼m maiden at Curragh last time. Open to further improvement and wears first-time visor dro

races.name: Richard Davis Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict: ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY should go on improving over fences and can make it 2-2 in this sphere. Rockvale is up 8 lb for his Southwell romp and can go well again now he's got his head in front. Jimmyjeroo returns with his yard in good form and could be in the hunt if ready to go.

runners.note: Fair hurdles winner for Henry de Bromhead who turned in her best effort for current connections when third of 6 in 3m Chepstow handicap hurdle in April. Lost her action on only previous go over fences and could fare bett
Made all in 21f Hereford handicap chase in April 2025 and was proving consistent in this sphere when last seen a year ago. Returns with yard in best run of form for a long time.

Looked like one with problems towards the end of his time with Dan Skelton. Fair third over C&D on stable/chasing debut in May but has gone backwards since, first-time cheekpieces not stopping the rot here last time.

Firmly in the groove for new yard, runner-up in 19f novice handicap hurdle at Fontwell (very strong form) before opening account on chase debut in 2m handicap here a fortnight ago, surviving a scare early in the straight
Couple of fair runs in staying hurdles last season and no reason why he can't make an impact over fences. His mark looks stiff, though.

Won 3m Chepstow handicap hurdle in April 2025 and matched the pick of his hurdling form after 11 weeks off when fourth on chase debut there when last seen in March (sent off favourite). That race has thrown up a couple o
Maiden but placed on 4 of his last 5 starts, plugging on to go second between the last 2 at Newton Abbot (3¼m) when last seen in June. Drop back in trip not sure to suit.
Off the mark at second attempt over fences when making all over C&D last summer. Disappointing since, brushed aside from 5 out here 3 months ago. Needs a revival.

Off the mark in 2½m Southwell handicap chase a fortnight ago, jumping more fluently and finally putting it all together from reduced mark, with the addition of cheekpieces perhaps pivotal. Can go well again despite an 8

Doubled his tally back over hurdles in 10-runner handicap over this trip here last month, well ridden by this pilot. Good third to Rockvale back over fences at Southwell since but probably only playing for a place again.

races.name: Join Racing TV Now Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict: MOTAWAARED certainly wasn't winning out of turn at Ayr on Thursday but he's a consistent and in-form performer, which cannot be said about most of these. The follow-up is therefore on the cards, with Pride of Nepal and Mudita heading the opposition.

Dropped in the weights and back in very good form of late with the cheekpieces added, readily doubling his tally in 10-runner handicap at Hamilton (1m, soft, 7/4) 18 days ago by 3¾ lengths. Back up 7 lb and not in the sa

Had a purple patch during first half of this season, completing a 4-timer over further at Ripon in June. Subsequent exploits suggest the handicapper has had his measure but this is easier than the race he contested on st

Doubled his tally in handicaps at Hamilton (1m) in August but not for the first time this year he failed to back that up when sixth of 9 at Carlisle (1m) 3 weeks later. Redcar run latest is easy to excuse given how the r

Low-mileage filly who was much improved when beating a subsequent winner to open her account at Southwell in late-July. Excuses next 2 starts but fitted with a tongue tie, she didn't look as at home switched to turf at A

Gained reward for a series of solid efforts when finally off the mark on heavy ground at Ayr on Thursday. Suited by way race developed but up just 2 lb so follow-up claims are bright back in distance.

Ripon maiden winner who caught the eye when well-backed fourth in Class 5 handicap at Redcar (1¼m, good) in August. Best not judged on subsequent effort in higher grade at Beverley (heavy) but hooded, it was harder to fi
Added another 2 wins to his tally over longer trips this season. Drop to 9f looked against him at Newmarket and didn't fare much better on all-weather 2 weeks ago. Visor replaces cheekpieces.
Sole success came when fitted with first-time cheekpieces at Wolverhampton last autumn. Made the frame twice for this yard but has been well held on last 3 starts. Cheekpieces back on.

races.name: Shape Engineering EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The newcomers look the one's to concentrate on with the well-bred BORN THIS WAY the pick. Amandari represents a yard who does well with their debutants and is next best, with Fort McHenry another to consider.

runners.note: Foaled May 9. €70,000 2-y-o, Invincible Spirit colt. Brother to 3 winners, including useful 2-y-o 6f-7f winner in France Spirit Gal and winner abroad Awesome Spirit Gal. The fitting of a hood for his debut is a concern b

Foaled March 22. 240,000 gns yearling, Wootton Bassett colt. Dam, third at 1¼m (stayed 1½m), sister to smart 1m winner Sir John Lavery out of smart winner up to 9.5f (2-y-o 7f winner) Race For The Stars. Yard's runners u
Foaled February 18. 50,000 gns yearling, 160,000 gns 2-y-o, Starspangledbanner colt. Makes appeal on paper and market may be best guide.
€200,000 yearling, Wootton Bassett colt. Badly needed experience when sixth of 7 in maiden at Catterick (7f, good to firm, 9/2) on debut 12 days ago. Ought to do better somewhere down the line.

Foaled April 3. 66,000 gns yearling, Zoustar gelding. Brother to 5.5f winner in US Regalton and half-brother to smart 6f winner Willem Twee. Dam unraced half-sister to smart winner up to 7f Mehronissa. Market probably be

Foaled March 21. 22,500 gns foal, 80,000 gns yearling, Space Blues colt. Dam, placed at 7f at 2 yrs, half-sister to useful 7f-10.7f winner Hawke out of smart winner up to 10.5f (2-y-o 1m winner) (stayed 12.5f) Australie.
€20,000 foal, 105,000 gns yearling. Maxios colt. 28/1, never involved when last of 11 in maiden at Kempton (1m) on debut 12 days ago. May be one for handicaps given connections.

races.name: Guinness Handicap
races.verdict: Successful on 2 of his first 3 starts this season, LA LA LUCRATIVE has been holding his form well since and he is taken to resume winning ways back at the scene of his latest victory. The main danger could be Mercurial, whose best effort of the season came when third here on his penultimate outing, with Earls completing the shortlist.

runners.note: Left debut form behind when winning 6f maiden at Fairyhouse last spring. Little impact in 2 handicaps since, though, returning from 13 months off when thirteenth of 17 at the Curragh (7f) in June. This should reveal more

Didn't need to improve to open her account at the tenth time of asking in 4-runner novice at Chester last month. Ran well back in a handicap when fourth of 11 at Listowel 20 days ago, though has something to find from he

Showed improved form fitted with cheekpieces when justifying support in 16-runner maiden at the Curragh (6f) on return in March. However, has finished well held in 2 handicaps since, so has a bit to prove after 4 months

Won 3 times in claimers at around 1m during the summer and gained a first handicap success at Down Royal (7f) 2 weeks ago, scoring comfortably. Free-going front runner who can give a good account with stall 1 to work fro
Recorded back-to-back nursery wins over 6f last year. Returned to his best when runner-up at Fairyhouse (6f) in June but below form all 3 starts since.

Much improved second time up when winning maiden over this C&D in August. Wasn't able to justify favouritism when fourth of 5 on handicap debut at Bellewstown (1m) 11 days ago, though did shape third best for most of the

3-time course winner with his latest success here last autumn. Runner-up 3 times in a row this season but hasn't been in the same form of late. However, he's now 4 lb below his last winning mark so is one to note.

Off the mark for the year at Limerick (1m) in June and won with a bit to spare at Gowran last month. Well below form back at Gowran (9.5f) 23 days ago, but had been in good heart prior to that so could fare better back d

Well backed when making a successful handicap debut at Fairyhouse (7f) in July and shaped as if still in form when sixth of 22 at the Curragh (6f) 8 days ago. Not ruled out with hood refitted back up in trip.

Sole victory came back in April 2024 but there have been better signs this season, including when close third here in August. Below-par effort at Listowel last time but he could bounce back at this venue. Interesting fro

Took advantage of his much-reduced mark at Listowel in May and also scored at this course the following month. Has continued in good heart since, runner-up back at Listowel 20 days ago. Can make another bold bid in his c

Winner here last autumn and overcame the worst of the draw to record a first success this season at Bellewstown (1m) 12 days ago. Has gone back up 8 lb in the weights which will make life tougher this time around.

Winner of a Limerick claimer (11.5f) for Denis Hogan last summer but hasn't gone on in handicaps for current yard, running poorly after 7 months off when well held at Down Royal (10.5f) in September. Has work to do back
Fair form when third in 6f maiden at the Curragh a year ago but no better than mid-division this season, seventh of 14 in handicap at Bellewstown (1m) 12 days ago.
Good third over this C&D on handicap debut, before not seen to best effect next 2 outings. However, ran poorly at Gowran 6 weeks ago so needs to get back on track.
Made the frame 4 times in maiden company in first half of the year but has lost his way since, again finishing well held in maiden at Bellewstown (1m) 12 days ago. RESERVE.

races.name: CopyBet For Champions League Profit Boosts Handicap Chase
races.verdict: A point background suggests SONYOURASTAR should take to fences and he's selected to gain compensation for his near miss over hurdles here last month. Ballynaheer won 4 times last season and his latest Fontwell second shows he's resumed in good form. Moonlightinthepark may benefit from this longer trip and is next on the list.

runners.note: Four wins last season, the latest at Market Rasen (3m) in April. Had a next-time-out winner behind in third when second at Fontwell (3¼m, good to firm) 20 days ago. More solid than most of these.
Capitalised on a much-reduced mark when winning 16-runner handicap hurdle at Uttoxeter in July but not in the same form over fences here a month later and also below par back hurdling since.
Gained reward for consistency when taking Sedgefield maiden hurdle in February 2025. Placed in first 3 chases but made hard work of it when only fifth at Bangor latest, going in snatches.

Low-mileage 6-y-o who is steadily progressing, going close in 23f course handicap hurdle latest. Cheekpieces are added for chase debut (reached frame in a point). Unexposed at staying trips and leading claims.

No impact in handicap hurdles, including for new yard after 12 months off at Ffos Las in April. Stable among the winners but could only consider if backed switched to fences. Wears first-time cheekpieces.
Refitting of headgear back over fences helped him stop the slide when runner-up at Newton Abbot (3¼m) in July. Failed to build on it when 15 lengths last of 4 at Fontwell since.
Improved second on 2½m Warwick chase and handicap debut in first-time cheekpieces (retained) 3 weeks ago. Made hard work of that and now steps back up in trip.

Not the easiest to catch right but was on a going day when running out a wide-margin winner of a weak affair at Hereford (25f) in February 2025. However, ran one of his moody races back from 18 months off at Fontwell at
Runner-up sole start in Irish points. Modest form under Rules so far but it is possible this longer trip will suit her.
Latest win in chase at Fontwell in March. 9/2, respectable fifth of 11 there (3¼m, good) in May. Off since but he's run well fresh before.

races.name: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: VEGASMILE looked a very uncomplicated 2-y-o when making all here a month ago and in the right hands to go on improving, he can concede 4 lb to Blue Pete, who is promising in his own right upped in trip.

runners.note: Failed to land the odds on debut over C&D in August but much more like it back here 3 weeks later when making all in impressive fashion. Bred to be useful and can go on improving.

Blue Point colt who continued theme of race-by-race progress when a keeping-on second over 6f at Redcar a month ago, clear of the rest. Winner that day has improved since and he looks ready for 7f. More to come.
Showed more than on debut when fourth at Newcastle (7f). Looks a handicap project over further.
Limited short-term promise both starts last month.

races.name: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: STATUS SYMBOL went off a big price but shaped with plenty of promise on debut and gets the verdict to come out on top second time out. Quintillion showed much improved form last time and rates an obvious danger with further progress likely, with Deira Moon also entitled to be in the mix again.

runners.note: Third in a Lingfield maiden on debut in May which worked out well and stepped up to win 12-runner similar event at Bath (1m, good to firm, 10/3) last month by 1¾ lengths from Deira Moon, suited by increase in trip. Goes
Cracksman colt. Looked in need of more time when seventh of 8 in novice (33/1) at Kempton (1m) on debut in August. Others preferred.

Twice-raced Galiway colt. 25/1, seventh of 8 in maiden at Goodwood (1¼m, good to firm) 19 days ago. Needs this run for a mark.

Showed much more second time up when length behind Wykehurst Park in maiden (25/1) at this course (9f, good) 25 days ago, suited by step up in trip. Likely to progress further with the extra distance promising to suit.

Thrice-raced maiden who's found only one too good on last 2 starts, latest when 1¼ lengths behind Please Don't Go in 8-runner maiden at Goodwood (1¼m, good to firm) 19 days ago. Should be in the mix again.
Behind in 2 races at Kempton. Now visored for the first time and will make more appeal in handicaps.

45,000 gns foal, Space Blues colt. Shaped well when 3¾ lengths fourth of 9 to Donegan in novice (50/1) at Kempton (1m) on debut 19 days ago, rallying late on. Looked as if in need of a stiffer test of stamina and is sure
27,000 gns yearling, Saxon Warrior filly. 10/1, green when last of 9 in maiden at Leicester (1m, good to firm) on debut 6 days ago. More needed turned out again quickly.

Foaled March 2. €30,000 yearling, Saxon Warrior filly. Half-sister to 9f-1½m winner Golden Vale. Dam, French 15f winner, sister to smart 1m-12.4f winner Tashaar out of useful 9.7f winner Three Moons. Market best guide.

races.name: Roscommon Racecourse On Facebook Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict: ALEX BELARDO can have a line put through his Down Royal effort 14 days ago where he endured a nightmare passage and looks worth chancing now back on his last winning mark and returned to this level. Ella's Gold was caught a bit too far back last time, but ran well at Navan in August and could prove the main danger if reverting to more positive tactics here. Buttermere Ridge kept on when third at L

Didn't show much in 3 starts for Richard Hannon (sold for 11,000 gns) and similar story on debut for new yard at Gowran 23 days ago.

Hasn't made much impact in a trio of maidens and marked improvement needed now handicapping, though booking of Colin Keane catches the eye and well worth a look in the betting as a result.

On a long losing sequence but one of his better efforts when fifth of 14 in handicap at Roscommon (7f, good to soft) on return in August. Typically failed to back that up at Listowel last time, though.
Poor maiden handicapper whose sole in-frame finish came over this C&D last spring. Difficult to fancy.
Veteran on a long losing run and his fourth here in August is very much a standout this season.
Frustrating filly who hasn't made much impact in a trio of outings this year. Cheekpieces removed.
Infrequent winner who has been operating below his best on all-weather/turf in recent starts. Others more persuasive.

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Chase
races.verdict: A recent C&D outing should have set up KALLY DES BRUYERES nicely for this and he can show he's still on a favourable mark. Alex Hales has his team in great nick so the returning Away For The Night may provide the chief threat. A point win suggests Double Indemnity may take to fences and he's next on the list.

Modest maiden hurdler but already a better chaser, getting off the mark at the second attempt at Plumpton (17, good) in April. Good second at Hereford the following month. Returns from break with his yard in really good
Notched a second career win in 11-runner handicap chase at Ffos Las (19f, soft) in April but got to be a chance he'll need this first outing since.
Course handicap hurdle winner who dominated a small-field race at Huntingdon in May on her second outing over fences. 4 lb higher in a slightly deeper race now and hasn't been seen for 140 days.
Remains a maiden after 18 runs but posted one of his better recent efforts when second of 5 over C&D in May. Off since.
Made all in 2m course maiden hurdle last month. Third in a Plumpton handicap hurdle 16 days later but ran poorly switched to fences over C&D since.

Dual winner over hurdles who justified strong support on second chase start at Market Rasen in April, with the form franked by the runner-up since. Shaped as if better for run after 5 months off when fifth of 9 over C&D

Fair Flat winner. Offered little in handicap hurdles prior to making a successful chasing debut in a weak 4-runner event at Fakenham in May. Placed in chase and hurdle since but ran poorly with a visor added at Newton Ab
Modest winner on Flat but maiden over hurdles, finishing a respectable fifth in handicap here on latest outing 32 days ago. Unseated on previous chase start.

races.name: Kick Start Your Career With The SRA Selling Stakes
races.verdict: POSSESSIVE didn't kick on after a promising winning debut for Karl Burke but new connections are quick to drop him in grade and he's more than capable of winning on these terms. Donna Beauty is the obvious threat assuming she shrugs aside a heavy defeat in a nursery, with Mick's The Boy expected to plug on into a place.

runners.note: Won a 7f maiden on Newcastle's all-weather in June. Found the going tough in a nursery/sales race twice since and more needed on these terms, even down in grade.

Looked useful when making a winning debut in 8-runner 6f novice at York in May. Below expectations in the Woodcote Stakes at Epsom next time and also failed to land the odds in a lesser race at Thirsk, albeit it wasn't a

Consistent type who doubled her tally in 7f Redcar seller in August. Failed to get home in the mud at Beverley and also not on her game switched to all-weather. Exposed and this is a better race than the Redcar one.

Best effort when chasing home subsequent Gimcrack winner Arapaho Gold in a Thirsk novice in July. Looked at home over 7f when plugging on for fourth at Wolverhampton 3 weeks ago and he should be keeping on well again at
Son of Space Traveller who looks a stable lesser light after 2 runs.

Had looked an awkward ride but more straightforward when making all in 6f Chester novice (soft) last month. That form reads pretty well in the context of this but she must cast aside a very heavy defeat switched to a nur
Improved to get off the mark in an ordinary maiden at Pontefract (6f) in June. More miss than hit since and her level is very well established.
Exposed as modest over various trips so set to struggle on these terms.
Runner-up in a C&D seller in June but that race wasn't as strong as this one and her limitations have been exposed in nurseries since.

races.name: AKS Skip Hire Services Handicap
races.verdict: PACE ATTACK is taken to bounce back returned to all-weather with the drop back in trip another likely plus for Sir Mark Prescott's 3-y-o. Astracornus and Madjid appeal as the main dangers in quite an open race.

runners.note: Gained a first win since his debut in 1½m handicap at Newbury in May. Ran well when third at Haydock last month, proving effective in testing conditions. Can give another good account.
Low-mileage 5-y-o got off the mark at Newcastle (1m) last November. Ran just 3 times this season, making the frame on each occasion, latest when fourth of 17 at Doncaster last month. Each-way claims.

Sixteen runs since last win in 2024. Hasn't run too badly in 3 starts for current yard this season, his mark continuing to fall as a result. Is very well handicapped at present, though needs to show a bit more before bec

Steadily progressive last year and justified strong support on his second start of the year with a win at Goodwood in June. Well held both starts since after racing freely and betting may provide clues.

Won over 7f at Wolverhampton on debut in December and was runner-up at Lingfield on first start since last month. Looked set to go close on handicap bow at Southwell next time before veering badly late on and may need mo

Successful on handicap debut at Nottingham prior to being narrowly denied at Newbury (both solid form). Creditable 3¼-length fourth of 13 at Goodwood latest, a more marked tendency to hang right possibly more to do with

Improved when made all in back-to-back handicaps at Newmarket and Kempton in the summer. Turned over at short prices on last 2 starts and may prove vulnerable for win purposes again but should be thereabouts.

Lightly-raced maiden. Filled the same position as on debut when runner-up on his return at Southwell in April, though he'd surely have won had he not hung badly right. Off 4 months and failed to beat a rival in handicap
Lightly-raced maiden. Placed on last 3 of 4 starts in juvenile season last year. Blinkers are discarded on return after 13 months off and significantly up in trip which should suit on pedigree.

Made typical progress switched to handicaps/longer trips, getting off the mark at Southwell in late-August and backed that up when third at Lingfield the following month. Didn't appeal to relish the longer trip at Redcar

Proved a different proposition upped further in trip when scoring comfortably at Ffos Las (1½m) in June. Has failed to back that up since, being let down by her free-going tendencies. Others more persuasive.
Got off the mark at Kempton in April and added to that with success at Windsor in August. Wasn't in the same form when third of 5 at former course last month. May find a few too strong.

races.name: Roscommon Racecourse On Facebook Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict: MOGWLI is firmly in the veteran stage of his career but took a step back in the right direction when fourth at Thurles on Thursday and looks worth chancing from a basement mark. Cisterna is hard to rely on but has already won over C&D this year and looks the main danger, while Draiocht is also respected from a good mark.

runners.note: More miss than hit since winning handicap at Cork and this race last autumn. Returns to handicap company on a reasonable mark, having been out of her depth in listed company at Listowel (200/1) in September, but plenty t

On long losing run and very little impact last 4 starts. Has dropped to a career-low mark and booking of Colin Keane always noteworthy, though hard to make a case for him unless the market should suddenly speak in his fa

Low-mileage 3-y-o. Improved when winning 9-runner handicap at Bellewstown (1m, soft) earlier this month and not ideally drawn when sixth of 15 to Jasmine Affanalis at Killarney 7 days ago. Should be in the mix.
Yet to win a race but he's pretty consistent, finishing in the frame on his last 2 starts, respectable 4½ lengths fourth of 14 to Navajo Point at Gowran on latest.
Twenty-four runs since last win in 2023 but has managed to be placed on 3 occasions this year, 6¼ lengths third of 14 to Selective Power at Bellewstown last time.
Losing run is mounting up but is proving consistent all the same, hitting the frame on each of his last 3 starts, 1¾ lengths fourth of 19 to Verified at Cork on latest. Should again give his running.

Comfortably scored in a 3-y-o C&D handicap in May. Bounced back to form when runner-up in this grade at Cork before underlining his inconsistency at Listowel (7f) last time. Return to this venue should suit, though, and
Maiden who has failed to match the fair form she showed as a 3-y-o this season, including for current connections last 3 starts.

Winner at Limerick in June but well held all 3 starts since. Returns from below that winning mark but has something to prove now and the market would have to speak firmly in her favour for her to become of interest.
Little show in maidens and on handicap debut. Significantly back down in trip here.
Back from 14 months off when scoring at Dundalk in July. Seems to save her best for that course, though, and well held at Laytown last time. Rare outing on turf here.

In frame first 2 starts this year. Hasn't been in the same form since, though shaped better than the bare result when 2¾ lengths fifth of 15 to Jasmine Affanalis at Killarney. Claims if building on that effort now.
Veteran on a long losing run and ran no sort of race after blowing the start at Bellewstown last time. Capable if on a going day but they are becoming far less frequent.

Veteran who won a pair of 1m handicaps last season. Hasn't fired this year but took a step back in the right direction when 3 lengths fourth of 13 to Starflow at Thurles last time. Has handled quick turnarounds in the pa

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Novices' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: POTTERS CHARM took his form over hurdles to a smart level last season, comfortably winning a Grade 2 at Fontwell early this year, and he is fancied to make a successful chasing debut with his yard enjoying a most productive spell. He gets the vote ahead of Jupiter des Mottes, who isn't taken lightly on first start for Dan Skelton.

Grade 1 novice winner over hurdles who showed smart form last season, landing the odds in a Fontwell Grade 2 (19f) in February. Found things tougher back at the highest level at Aintree when last seen, but he's a notewor

races.verdict: AXEL BLEUE is yet to run a bad race at Worcester and can land a third C&D handicap of the campaign, still looking on a fair mark having finished with running left at Uttoxeter last time. Big Cadillac and Island Bridge are a couple of interesting runners going chasing for the first time.

runners.note: Ended a losing run at Warwick (3m) on New Year's Eve and completed for the first time since at Chepstow when last seen in April. This track shouldn't put too much emphasis on his sketchy jumping and he's not without a ch
Two-time 3m novice winner over hurdles in 2024 and was in good form in handicaps when last seen. Bred to do just as well over fences and worth a look on reappearance.

Irish point winner who scored twice in staying handicap hurdles last season and was going the right way in the spring. Should make his mark over fences, although Harry Skelton has seemingly plumped for Big Cadillac here.

Placed in a bumper and fair form when reaching the frame in maiden/novice hurdles at up to 3m last season. Will need to jump better than he did when last seen at Chepstow now chasing on return though yard should have him

Beat now useful Gentleman Toboot on bumper debut but didn't fulfil his potential over hurdles last season. Stoutly-bred point winner could come into his own now going chasing, however, and he looks the stable first strin
Fair chaser who won at Hereford (25f) in December 2024 and responded well to a visor when second at Ascot/Wincanton last season. On a fair mark on return for in-form stable.

Had a fine summer here, winning a couple of C&D handicaps (latest after a breathing operation). Caught too far back and didn't jump too well at Uttoxeter last time (finished with running left) and likely to go close back

Landed a hat-trick of 2½m wins at Uttoxeter and this track earlier this season. Revised mark didn't look beyond him at Bangor last time (again ran well from the front back from 9 weeks off). This step up in trip isn't ce

races.name: Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: ALBERICH was well backed and just failed behind Showcasing Glory (runs in the first division at 16.12) on his debut at Newcastle 3 weeks ago. That was a promising start and could improve past the penalised Tredegar Square who was successful first time up here in August. Harpagoside is an interesting newcomer hailing from a stable that has had a fine season with its juveniles.

runners.note: Knew his job and knuckled down well to make a winning start in 11-runner maiden at Lingfield (7f, all-weather) in August. Failed to see out 1m here 5 weeks ago and needs to quickly get back on track.

Stable has had plenty of success with this family and he became another winning newcomer for them this season when landing 12-runner C&D maiden 9 weeks ago. Should progress and can go well again under a penalty under Ois

Well backed and displayed plenty of ability when neck second of 13 to Showcasing Glory (runs in the first division) starting out at Newcastle (7f) 2 weeks ago. Yard brings its juveniles on plenty for an outing so he shou

Fair form when third in novices on firm/good to firm at Windsor (6f) and Lingfield (5f) in the summer. Sent off at long odds on his nursery debut at Newmarket (7f) 9 weeks ago and made little impact. Has been gelded and
Foaled March 16. Mohaather colt. Half-brother to useful 7f winner Molaqab. Stable had a great season with 2-y-os (good record on all-weather). Worth a look.
Foaled May 17. €28,000 yearling, Japan gelding. Dam 2-y-o 1m winner in Germany. May need time and a longer trip.
22,000 gns Twilight Son gelding from the family of multiple Group 1 winner Russian Rhythm. Sent off 150/1 but showed a bit in 7f Leicester maiden on debut 3 weeks ago.
Cheap purchase who looked badly in need of the experience when well beaten on debut at Wolverhampton (6f) 7 weeks ago.
Foaled March 27. Lightning Spear gelding. Brother to 6f winner Thunderous Love and half-brother to 2-y-o 6f winner Hill Cove. Yard's newcomers this year have been better for a run.
Mixed pedigree (by a Group 1-winning juvenile sprinter but out of a relative to a stayer) and looked one for the longer term in 7f Haydock novice on debut early last month.
Foaled February 3. Bobby's Kitten filly. Dam 1½m winner out of useful French 1m-9.7f winner Alumna. Drawn widest and probably one for the future.

races.name: Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict: NED BROY made his first start over this far on the Flat a winning one at Newcastle and he can build on that effort to score again. The pair of Jim Goldie-trained runners are feared most, with Storm On Jura the pick for second from her reduced mark, ahead of Alpine Sierra.

runners.note: Placed twice upon returning to the Flat this season and, upped to 2m, gained a deserved first success in 9-runner handicap at Newcastle 10 weeks ago (the second scored next time). Strong contender with more still to offe

From his career-low mark, recorded a first win for current yard in 6-runner contest at this course (1¾m) 12 days ago, well ridden having typically been slowly away (sometimes markedly so). Will need things to drop right

Landed a hat-trick in May, including success at this course (12.5f). After a couple of lesser efforts has returned to form the last twice, fourth of 10 at Ayr (13f) 24 days ago, and he's back down to his last winning mar

Still looking for a breakthrough victory but finished closer than previously when ¾-length second of 8 in handicap at Catterick (1¾m) in August. Wasn't in the same form, though, when fifth of 9 at Newcastle (12.5f) last
Remains a maiden but was only just edged out at Hamilton (1½m, soft) last month. Also finished runner-up over the same C&D 2 weeks ago and she could be in the mix as she goes up in distance.

Had struggled for form since returning from 14-month absence, before bouncing back when second of 9 in handicap at Southwell 20 days ago. Has dropped a long way in the weights, though needs to be able to back up latest e

Had been showing better signs switched to more positive tactics and, upped to this trip, got off the mark when making all at Catterick 12 days ago. Looks the likely pace angle in this race and can give another good accou

Sole win came at Newcastle (1¼m) last summer. Has made the frame on several occasions this year but arrives on the back of 2 lesser efforts, last of 6 in race won by Simple Star here (1¾m) 12 days ago. Visor back on.

races.name: Moulton Racing Club Handicap
races.verdict: MERAPI shaped well until the longer trip seemed to stretch her when fourth at Leicester last month and she can get off the mark in a thin race. Abu Royal and Potters Prince both arrive after a couple of good efforts and can complete the 1-2-3.

runners.note: 7f winner on debut for Clive Cox last summer and posted easily his most encouraging effort for current yard when third of 14 at Southwell (1m) in August but unsurprisingly wasn't in the same form there 25 days ago.
Opened her account switched to a nursery over 6f here last October but badly out of sorts this year. Significantly up in trip now.

Runner-up 3 times in the spring (including at C&D) and shaped with some promise after a 3-month break when fourth of 9 in handicap at Leicester (1¼m, good) 34 days ago. Drop back in trip should suit and she's high on the
Winless since 2023 and didn't offer too much in 2 outings last year. Very well treated if retaining ability after another 14-month break, though, and market might prove best guide.

Low-mileage 4-y-o who ran right up to his best when second of 13 at Southwell (1m) towards the end of September and ran respectably enough when sixth of 12 in handicap at that same C&D on Saturday. Respected after quick

Back to winning ways at Chepstow in June and followed up in a classified event at Lingfield 12 days later. Back to form after a lesser effort when third of 14 in handicap at Bath (1m, good to firm) 30 days ago, albeit do
Well held on all 3 handicap starts. Drops significantly in trip in first-time blinkers.
Recorded her fourth course success in 10-runner classified event at C&D in August. Well beaten at Brighton next time, though had her blindfold removed late at Leicester 3 weeks ago.
Sole win came back in 2023 but he arrives in decent heart, again running creditably when fourth of 10 in handicap (5/1) at Beverley (8.5f, good) 26 days ago.
Much improved with cheekpieces added when winning at Beverley on handicap debut (8.5f, good) last month. Not quite in the same form over 1¼m there 6 days later.

Posted career best when narrowly winning 12-runner handicap at Windsor (1m, good to soft) in June but not in the same form after a 10-week break at Ffos Las last time. Still just 2 lb above that winning mark, though.
Hasn't beaten a rival to date, including on handicap bow last time. Makes turf debut in first-time blinkers.

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: SAILOR'S RETURN was unlucky last time and can go one better with the forecast strong pace expected to suit her run style. The in-form Espanita should be thereabouts again, with Maria Da Silva taken to see out the places.

runners.note: Much improved when getting off the mark in 7f maiden here in January and followed up on handicap debut over C&D the following month. Shaped well taking on older rivals for the first time when fourth at Windsor last month
Successful 3 times this year, twice over 7f at Wolverhampton and adding to her tally at Lingfield (1m) in September. Close runner-up on last 2 starts and should remain competitive.

Left Miss Natalia Lupini and improved when third of 10 in handicap at Kempton (1m, 5/1) 19 days ago, keeping on well under hands-and-heels riding. Makes tapeta debut and any positive market vibes should be noted.
5-time C&D winner who found run of in-the-frame efforts come to an end in soft ground 12-runner handicap at Ayr 25 days ago. Can't be ignored back round here.

Off the mark at fifth attempt for David O'Meara when winning at Southwell in August. Shaped very well when neck second of 10 to Dalamara over C&D 11 days ago, not ideally placed in modestly-run race. Has to be taken seri

C&D novice winner in February and generally maintained form for former yard after. However, has been well beaten on last 2 starts, latest at Southwell on debut for new yard, and has a bit to prove at present.

Much improved following switch to Ed Bethell, landing back-to-back 1m handicaps at Hamilton/Ripon in the summer. Shaped as if still in good form when fifth of 10 in handicap (10/3) at Beverley (8.5f, good to firm) 20 day

Showed improved form making handicap debut when second of 4 at Thirsk in July, going close to reeling in one who had the run of the race. Well held both starts since and is hard to make a case for as a result.

Bagged handicaps at Pontefract in June and Nottingham in July. Placed twice at Redcar since but ran below form there last time. Is yet to prove effective on all-weather and can be passed over, even off this lower mark.

Made a promising start for this yard when switched to front-running tactics and finishing placed in back-to-back handicaps at Ayr in July. Not in same form since and bounce back required on all-weather debut.
All 3 successes have come over C&D, including twice this season. Quickly back to form when second of 9 in handicap at Redcar (1¼m, good to soft, 12/1) 9 days ago. Place claims.

races.name: Thank You For Your Support Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict: BALLAGHKEEN is less exposed than most she meets here and can defy a penalty to follow up last week's Navan win. Royal Belief, Deluca Chop and Autocrat are also shortlisted in a decent race for the grade.

runners.note: Caught the eye on last month's return and produced a much improved effort to get off the mark in a 16-runner handicap (14/1) at Navan (1¼m, good to soft) 5 days ago. Looks the one to beat under a penalty.

Lightly-raced maiden in this sphere but was much improved over hurdles when winning 12-runner event at Limerick (2m, soft, 6/1) in March prior to good second back on the Flat at Gowran (13.7f, soft) the following month.

Little impact in a trio of maidens but with blinkers applied showed improved form when third of 12 on handicap debut at Down Royal (13f) last month and backed that up with another creditable 3 lengths fourth of 11 to Aut

Attracted some support upped in trip and showed first form after a 4-month break when winning at Sligo in early-August. Quickly back on track in first-time cheekpieces when second of 11 in handicap (11/2) at Bellewstown

Secured back-to-back successes at Navan/Down Royal in June and has remained in good form since, again running well when second of 14 in handicap at Dundalk (1½m) 17 days ago. Cheekpieces back on. Looks competitive on for

Ran to only a modest level in maidens and hasn't improved in 2 handicap outings so far. Cheekpieces go on now.

Shaped as if back in form prior to falling in a handicap hurdle at Downpatrick (2¼m, good to soft) 24 days ago but has raced on the level only once since 2024, so hard to know what to expect in this sphere.
Maiden handicapper who ran creditably when third of 14 in handicap (25/1) at Thurles (12.7f, good to soft) 4 days ago. Tongue strap goes on and place claims again.

Six-time winner at Dundalk who scored for the first time on turf in an 11-runner handicap at Bellewstown (12.4f, soft) 11 days ago by 1¾ lengths from Among The Pines. Still well treated on old form after 6 lb rise.

Much improved when winning a 16-runner handicap hurdle (50/1) at this course (2m, good to soft) 14 days ago, readily. Little show in this sphere to date but that makes her very interesting making her Flat handicap debut
Unreliable sort. Eighteen runs since last win in 2024. Eleventh of 15 in handicap at Listowel (7f, good to soft, 13/2) 20 days ago. Significantly up in trip and tricky to fancy.
One win from 25 Flat runs. Made the frame for the second start in a row when fourth of 14 in handicap at Down Royal (11f, good to soft) 14 days ago. Cheekpieces back on.

Fair winner over hurdles but lightly raced in recent seasons, well below his best in 2 handicaps on the Flat in 2025. Creditable sixth of 15 in handicap hurdle at last year's Galway Festival, though has been absent 14 mo
No better than mid-field in varied events, merely passing beaten rivals when fifth of 7 in handicap at Clonmel (17f, good, 12/1) 26 days ago.
No impact on Flat or over hurdles, offering nothing on return from 18 months off at Gowran last time. Goes up in trip sporting first-time cheekpieces after another 122 days off. RESERVE.
Lightly-raced maiden. 66/1, fifteenth of 16 in handicap at Naas (11f, good to firm) 50 days ago. Much more needed here. RESERVE.
Placed twice on the level in the spring but not quite in the same form over hurdles or in a Navan handicap on the Flat this autumn. RESERVE.

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: It's taken a while to get RAVISHING back to the track since her debut but that was a promising effort and she's taken to get the better of chief form rivals who have seemingly had their limitations exposed. Oceti has been gelded since last seen in the summer and might be the one to chase Roger Varian's filly home.

runners.note: Fair maiden. Freshened up since finishing well held in 7f Ascot handicap in July. Thereabouts if recapturing his best form. Has been gelded.
Placed on all 4 all-weather starts, although he wasn't at his best when turned over at short odds at Newcastle (6f) 17 days ago.

Hasn't really built on last October's C&D debut but was placed in a pair of all-weather maidens at Wolverhampton (6f/7f) earlier in the year. Below par in a turf novice at Lingfield in June and off since.
Has shown precious little on all 6 starts, including low-grade handicaps.
Third on her 6f Chelmsford debut in June 2025 but the form is only modest and she hasn't been seen since. Wears a tongue tie on return.
Charming Thought filly. Dam maiden (stayed 1m), half-sister to useful winner up to 1½m Latenightrequest. Best watched on debut unless the betting suggests otherwise.

No Nay Never filly who made an encouraging start to her career amidst greenness when third of 7f in 6f novice at Ascot last summer. Her absence since suggests it hasn't all gone to plan but she's very much the promising
Well held in 2 outings just under a year apart. Outsider.

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: GREAT BALLS O'FIRE found the step up to Group company a bit too much, certainly at this stage of his career but he'd impressed when making a winning debut with a bit to spare at Newmarket in August and is fancied to be seen to much better effect back in calmer waters. Val de Grey and Benbecula may emerge as the chief dangers to Richard Spencer's colt.

Lope Y Fernandez gelding who offered little at long odds in pair of novice/maidens last month. Low-grade nurseries promise to be more his thing after this.

150,000 gns yearling, Blue Point colt. Closely related to 8.3f winner Stella Lucente. Unfancied in the betting but he offered something to work on when sixth of 10 in a Newbury maiden (6f, firm) 7 weeks ago. In good hand

Perfect Power colt who appeals on paper and is in good hands but proved easy to back and finished well held when sixth of 7 in a Haydock novice (6f) 39 days ago. Should know more this time but others look stronger nevert

Minzaal filly shaped well when a debut third of 7 in novice at Haydock (7f, good to soft) last month. Failed to repeat that tackling 1m/soft ground back there 16 days ago and likely she still has more to offer, not least

races.name: Unibet Supports Safer Gambling Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: WADOODA is taken to make light of her absence and prove too strong for Foxy Night. Gosden stable newcomer Wosta would also very much enter the reckoning should the betting speak in her favour.

runners.note: Has beaten less than a handful home across 4 starts, including a low-grade handicap. First-time cheekpieces need to spark major improvement.

Well-related Without Parole filly who made an encouraging start with third of 5 in novice at Lingfield (1m, all-weather) last month. Confirmed she possesses a fair level of ability when second of 4 in 7f Brighton maiden
Roseman filly. Half-sister to useful Italian 2-y-o 5.5f winner Crisaff's Queen and winner up to 1¼m No Stopping Her. This one is likely best watched on debut.

Well-bred daughter of Too Darn Hot who returned from 14 months off with an improved second in 1m Pontefract maiden 25 days ago. The form isn't anything special but she has the potential to build on it for top stable.
Rare poor effort at Newcastle last month but had found improvement when third on Hamilton handicap debut previously. First-time blinkers replace cheekpieces. Respected under Loughnane.
80/1, last of 10 in maiden at Wolverhampton (7f) on debut 73 days ago. Can only watch after that.

Mohaather filly. Half-sister to several winners, including winner up to 1¾m Noble Expression and 1¼m winner who became temperamental Land of Eagles. The stable wouldn't be a regular source of first-time-out winners.
Very well-bred daughter of Dubawi. Showed plenty of ability when 1¼-length second to a useful sort on 7f Newmarket debut last October. Off since but likely improver if all is well.
Make Believe filly. Half-sister to 1m winner Thyer and 9f winner Alsaba. Dam, 1m winner, half-sister to smart 5f-7f winner Lahore out of useful 2-y-o 1m winner Nayarra. Noteworthy newcomer.

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On Instagram Nursery
races.verdict: STARBURSTER finished fourth in a race that has thrown up winners on debut and she built on that effort following 3 months off when opening her account at Newbury 7 weeks ago. The runner up that day has tasted success twice since and with further progress beckoning, she makes plenty of appeal on nursery debut. races.name: Juddmonte EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: RHYTHM OF MY HEART sets a clear standard on her runner-up efforts and can make it third time lucky. Wolverhampton second Heavenly Parole might be the one to chase her home. Oisin Murphy-ridden debutante Fear The Dark needs monitoring in the betting.

runners.note: Little short-term encouragement in 7f races here and at Leicester in recent months. Hooded first time.

Foaled April 25. 26,000 gns Lope Y Fernandez filly. Half-sister to 3 winners, including useful winner up to 1m Oddyssey and winner up to 1m Echo Beach. Oisin Murphy is an interesting booking for this newcomer.
100/1, eighth of 10 in novice at Haydock (7f, soft) on debut 17 days ago. Needs to leave that well behind.
14/1, green when fifth of 9 in C&D novice on debut 19 days ago. May do better.
Calyx filly who offered little in 2 runs here last month.
Promising second on 7f course debut but has failed to build on it in 2 subsequent starts.
Foaled April 7. 14,000 gns Kameko half-sister to 3 winners, including 7f winner So Logical and French winner up to 10.4f Delicada. Bred to have a future and needs checking out in the betting.

Without Parole filly who stepped up significantly on her debut when second of 11 in maiden at Wolverhampton (8.6f) 24 days ago. Thereabouts under Loughnane but she'll need to raise her game to trouble Rhythm of My Heart.
Little impact in 3 starts and an outsider again.
Encouraging runner-up efforts over 7f here and 1m at Goodwood in August. Open to further progress and very much the one to beat.

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: MAE AMOR has eased a little in the weights and quickly bounced right back to form when finishing second in a C&D handicap 11 days ago, disputing lead late and denied on the bob. Successful from a higher mark in the spring, she looks a big player from a handy draw. Juan Les Pins is another to consider, whilst Kinnalargy requires a market check on debut for David O'Meara. Taygar is also respected.

Useful sort at best but has struggled in 5 runs since sold from Richard Hughes. Tumbling down the grades but hard to fancy at present.

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
races.verdict: A chance is taken on ORGAN who has a good draw and has been the subject of an interesting trainer change. Fantastic Fox finally got his head back in front last time and remains well treated on anything like his best form on this surface. Yorkshire is also of interest back on all-weather if Billy Loughnane is able to navigate him into a good position from stall 12.

runners.note: Forward-going type whose progress has halted since winning at Wolverhampton in the spring, with his attitude looking questionable on occasions.

Bounced back to winning ways in the Summer Cup at Thirsk (1m) in August but more miss than hit since. Has quickly dropped to 3 lb below the mark he defied at Thirsk but he's not one for maximum faith.

Most reliable at this track, winning 4 times over 7f, the latest in May. Creditable in-frame efforts over C&D on his last 2 outings but the outside stall could make life tricky.

Ey Up He's A Star, recent C&D winner Whiskey Pete and Amarachi head up the dangers, with Rugby Union not dismissed lightly either.
